description: Texts spoken in DECtalk's math mode: the signs of its math table standing alone between numbers and letters, and written against them; a percent sign, a decimal with no leading digit, numbers with an exponent; a text with no sign in it; ranges, a telephone number and dates, which the text stage reads in their own way outside the mode; money; the mode turned off again, set, turned on and off inside a text, and on together with the spelling mode. Written before any export and not edited afterwards.

entries.text: [:mode math on] So a-b, x+y, and 6*7.
[:mode math on] Half is 50 % or .5 of it.
[:mode math on] The boat came in at noon.
[:mode math on][:mode math off] Take 3 - 2 and 4 * 5.
Take 3 - 2. [:mode math on] Take 3 - 2. [:mode math off] Take 3 - 2.
The sum [:mode math on] 4 * 5 = 20 [:mode math off] is done.
